description_en: Unpublishes a publication record of an API product based on the API product ID and the publication record ID. Both identifiers are parameters in the /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications/{publicationId} path. The publication record is created by the PublishProduct operation and can be queried by the ListProductPublications operation. This operation only manages the publication record and does not delete the API product itself. To delete a product, use DeleteProduct. The response returns only the requestId, code, and message
description_zh: 按 API 产品 ID 与发布记录 ID 下线该 API 产品的一条发布记录：两个标识同为 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications/{publicationId} 路径上的参数，发布记录由发布API产品（PublishProduct）产生、可由获取API产品的发布信息（ListProductPublications）查询。本接口只操作发布记录，不删除 API 产品本身（删除产品请使用 DeleteProduct），响应只返回 requestId、code 与 message
kebab_example: aliyun apig unpublish-product --product-id product-xxxxxxxx --publication-id publication-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnpublishProduct

parameters.help_en: The API product ID, which is the primary ID of the API product resource and specifies the API product to which the publication record to be unpublished belongs. It shares the /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications path with the PublishProduct and ListProductPublications operations. This parameter is only used to locate the product to which the publication record belongs and does not delete the API product itself
parameters.help_zh: API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，指定要下线的发布记录所属的 API 产品；与 PublishProduct、ListProductPublications 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications 路径。本参数只用于定位发布记录所属的产品，不会删除 API 产品本身
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the publication record to be unpublished, which identifies the publication relationship between the API product and a HiMarket portal. It is returned in the data.publicationId field of the response after a successful PublishProduct operation and can be queried by the ListProductPublications and ListPortalPublications operations
parameters.help_zh: 要下线的发布记录 ID，标识该 API 产品与某个 HiMarket 门户之间的发布关系。由 PublishProduct 发布成功后在响应 data.publicationId 中返回，可由 ListProductPublications 与 ListPortalPublications 查询
parameters.name: publication_id
